mapper.sql: id, house_id, rabbit_id, cage_id, vaccine_name, vaccine_batch_no, dose, route, vaccinated_at, next_due_date, status, remark, request_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, operator_name, update_time
mapper.insert:
insert into vaccination_records (house_id, rabbit_id, cage_id, vaccine_name, vaccine_batch_no, dose, route, vaccinated_at, next_due_date, status, remark, request_id, create_by, update_by, operator_name) values
(#{it.houseId}, #{it.rabbitId}, #{it.cageId}, #{it.vaccineName}, #{it.vaccineBatchNo}, #{it.dose}, #{it.route}, #{it.vaccinatedAt}, #{it.nextDueDate}, #{it.status}, #{it.remark}, #{it.requestId}, #{it.createBy}, #{it.updateBy}, #{it.operatorName})
mapper.select: select from vaccination_records where house_id = #{houseId} and request_id = #{requestId} order by id asc

select vr.id, vr.house_id, vr.rabbit_id, vr.cage_id, vr.vaccine_name, vr.vaccine_batch_no, vr.dose, vr.route, vr.vaccinated_at, vr.next_due_date, vr.status, vr.remark, vr.request_id, vr.create_by, vr.create_time, vr.update_by, vr.operator_name, vr.update_time from vaccination_records vr inner join rabbits r on r.house_id = vr.house_id and r.id = vr.rabbit_id and r.is_active = true where vr.house_id = #{houseId} and vr.status = 'SCHEDULED' and vr.next_due_date is not null and vr.next_due_date <= #{now} order by vr.next_due_date asc, vr.id asc
